card.name: Spots right before "tested/studied" in trial text
card.fires_on: Nouns or words in clinical-study descriptions where a past-tense study word like tested, studied, evaluated or investigated is about to follow, e.g. agents, dose levels, regimens. Also the start of dosing/regimen terms.

modes.label: Before 'tested/studied'

card.writes: It pushes the model toward evaluation words such as evaluated, evaluation and evaluate as the next word.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say that a drug, dose or regimen was evaluated in a study.
